item.title: Saints Peter & Paul Parish Will Pause Middle School Program
item.description: Saints Peter & Paul Parish and School in Hopkinsville announced Monday it will suspend its Middle School program beginning this August, following a review of enrollment trends, long-term sustainability and extensive listening sessions with families and leadership.
